back2basics.text: A naval ship refit involves comprehensive maintenance and upgrades to extend the vessel's operational life and improve capabilities. Repowering refers to replacing the ship's propulsion system, often to enhance efficiency, reliability, or performance. Such projects are critical for maintaining naval readiness and often involve complex engineering and indigenous industrial participation.

2026-11-12-am-78b7c8bf96.deck: The Ministry of Defence signed a ₹498.58 crore contract with Cochin Shipyard Limited on November 11, 2026, for the normal refit and repowering of INS Betwa, a Brahmaputra-class frigate. This contract involves major propulsion system transformation and combat capability upgrades, reinforcing indigenous naval maintenance and supporting 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat'.

editor.why: Significant defence procurement and maintenance contract important for naval operational readiness.

back2basics.text: The judiciary in India can direct investigative agencies to register FIRs and ensure accountability in governance. Vigilance agencies like the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti Corruption (DVAC) investigate corruption allegations. Public procurement involves government processes to acquire goods or services, requiring transparency to prevent misuse of funds.

2026-11-12-am-8997bf8619.deck: The Madras High Court directed the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti Corruption (DVAC) to register a First Information Report (FIR) regarding alleged irregularities in procuring AI-generated books for the Periyar Arivulagam library. This case highlights judicial intervention in governance and anti-corruption, relevant for understanding accountability mechanisms in India.

mcq.stem:
Consider the following statements regarding the AI-generated book purchase scam case in Tamil Nadu:
1. The Madras High Court directed the DVAC to register an FIR based on a writ petition by DMK leader I. Paranthamen.
2. The Periyar Arivulagam library was established with a budget of ₹300 crore, including ₹50 crore for book procurement.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq.trap: A trap is confusing the petitioner or the court's role; the writ petition was filed by DMK leader I. Paranthamen, and the court directed DVAC to act, not the other way around.

body.label: Complaint and petition
body.text: DMK Legal Wing joint secretary I. Paranthamen filed a writ petition seeking a direction for DVAC to register an FIR based on his complaint about irregularities in book procurement for Periyar Arivulagam.

body.label: Allegations of AI-generated books
body.text: The complaint alleged that books supplied were AI-generated with fictitious authors and contained incorrect historical and factual information, raising doubts about authenticity.

body.label: Delay in FIR registration
body.text: Despite Paranthamen lodging the complaint on November 7, 2026, DVAC had not registered an FIR or informed him about any preliminary inquiry, prompting judicial action.

sections.heading: What triggered the Madras High Court's intervention?

body.label: Library establishment and funding
body.text: Periyar Arivulagam, a knowledge centre in Coimbatore, was established by the Tamil Nadu government at a cost of ₹300 crore, including ₹50 crore for book procurement.

body.label: Book selection process
body.text: A 112-member book recommendation committee was formed in November 2025, with meetings held in January 2026 and purchase orders issued in February 2026.

body.label: Public controversy
body.text: After the library's inauguration in October 2026, acclaimed author and committee member Perumal Murugan exposed the presence of AI-generated books with dubious content and pricing.

sections.heading: What is the background of the Periyar Arivulagam book purchase controversy?

body.text: The case highlights the importance of vigilance bodies like DVAC in investigating irregularities and the need for timely action on complaints.

body.label: Implications for public procurement
body.text: The controversy raises concerns about transparency and quality control in government procurement processes, especially involving new technologies like AI.

sections.heading: Why does this case matter for governance and anti-corruption?

back2basics.text: A credit guarantee scheme provides a guarantee to lending institutions against the risk of default by borrowers, encouraging banks to lend to sectors or groups that may lack collateral or credit history. This mechanism reduces the risk for lenders, thereby promoting financial inclusion and access to credit for small businesses and vulnerable sections.

2026-11-12-am-8eb3422e74.deck: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) scheme until March 2031 to support loans under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY). This extension facilitates collateral-free loans worth ₹12.6 lakh crore, promoting entrepreneurship and financial inclusion for micro enterprises.

mcq.stem:
Consider the following statements about the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) scheme:
1. The scheme provides credit guarantee coverage for loans extended under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana up to ₹20 lakh.
2. The guarantee fee under the scheme has been increased from 0.75% to 1% per annum for all loans.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq.trap: Statement 2 is incorrect because the guarantee fee has been decreased from 1% to 0.75% per annum for PMMY loans, not increased.

body.label: Purpose of the scheme
body.text: The CGFMU provides credit guarantee coverage to lending institutions against default risk for loans extended to eligible micro enterprises under PMMY, overdrafts under PMJDY accounts, and loans to Self Help Groups with portfolios between ₹10 lakh and ₹20 lakh.

body.label: Guarantee coverage and fee
body.text: Guarantee coverage is linked to disbursement amounts for working capital and outstanding amounts for term loans, reflecting actual risk exposure; the guarantee fee has been reduced from 1% to 0.75% per annum for PMMY loans, with no change for SHGs.

body.label: Administration
body.text: The scheme operates through the National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC), which provides the guarantee to lending institutions.

sections.heading: What is the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units scheme?

body.label: Extension approval
body.text: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the CGFMU scheme for five years up to March 31, 2031, covering the XVIth Finance Commission cycle (FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31).

body.label: Corpus and loan facilitation
body.text: A corpus of ₹5,000 crore has been approved to facilitate PMMY loans amounting to ₹12.6 lakh crore over the next five years.

body.label: Impact so far
body.text: Since its launch in January 2016, the scheme has catalyzed the sanctioning of over 60.36 crore loans totaling ₹43.34 lakh crore, enabling a new generation of entrepreneurs to access collateral-free loans.

sections.heading: What are the recent developments regarding the CGFMU scheme?

body.label: Promotes entrepreneurship
body.text: By providing collateral-free loans, the scheme helps aspiring entrepreneurs who previously could not access formal banking credit to start and grow their businesses.

body.label: Supports financial inclusion
body.text: The scheme extends credit guarantees to loans under PMMY, overdrafts under PMJDY, and loans to Self Help Groups, thereby supporting vulnerable and underserved sections of the economy.

body.label: Catalyst for MSME growth
body.text: The CGFMU acts as a catalyst for micro, small, and medium enterprises by mitigating lending risks for financial institutions, encouraging more credit flow to the sector.

sections.heading: Why does the CGFMU scheme matter for economic development?

back2basics.text: A metro rail system is an urban public transport network using trains running on dedicated tracks, often elevated or underground, to provide fast, efficient, and high-capacity transit. It helps reduce road traffic congestion, lowers pollution, and supports sustainable urban development by connecting key areas within cities.

back2basics.text: A CEPA is a type of free trade agreement that covers trade in goods, services, investment, and other economic cooperation areas. It aims to reduce tariffs and non-tariff barriers, facilitate market access, and promote economic integration between the partner countries.

2026-11-12-am-f2fc41a5b7.deck: India and Canada held discussions on November 11, 2026, to advance negotiations for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) aimed at boosting bilateral trade and investment.
